notes.title: Bug Fix patch 4/12
notes.content:
Hello all! I am taking some time to address some bugs on the PC build (Mac and Linux build will be posted in a few days):

Chapter Achievements should be propping just fine now

A movement bug that made Simone sometimes not appear in some places

A save system bug that I believe was causing some issues with the gameplay

Credits are accessible from the opening menu now


If you run into any more bugs, please let me know in the discussion board or on our discord.

notes.title: Quincy's Madness
notes.content:
June 12th, 2024:
Dr. Edward Kimble, the CEO and founder of AITIS, died of a heart attack brought about by extreme stress. Dr. Sable Kuhns, the Head of Research at AITIS, is given a task from a mysterious email, signed “MITBH”. Blood on the Thames appears on her computer, filled with hints and clues made for her. 

Follow her journey, as she discovers the truth behind Dr. Kimble's death.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902330/c8bdc4d861c0dd76eb9d0006a7e2f6796a993489.png[/img]


A new story told through that which Mini was not meant to see. Find the mystery behind the death of Dr. Kimble, and the secrets behind AITIS, a company that builds artificial intelligence simulations.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902330/d174f984bc66fe27a850e109adf0d55b77b8272a.jpg[/img]



All stories need a starting point, and this one begins with a company:

[url=aitis.org]AITIS, Artificial Intelligence Testing Initiative Services: Empowering Tomorrow’s Intelligence, Today[/url]




Good luck, Little Ones

MITBH

notes.title: Window mode and Menu Tutorial
notes.content:
From the options menu, there is now a windowed mode under graphics and a new tutorial. This tutorial is intended to clarify some frequently asked questions.

Other changes include:

Animation fixes
Typos
Several minor bugs and errors

notes.title: Blood On The Thames is a Victorian London murder mystery now available for Linux
notes.content:
Team Firestorm sent word that their recently released Victorian London murder mystery game Blood On The Thames is now supported on Linux. Looks really unique with the visual style!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/11/blood-on-the-thames-is-a-victorian-london-murder-mystery-now-available-for-linux

notes.title: Linux Build Live
notes.content:
We have a Linux build now! Hope you enjoy playing it!



A few other things have been fixed alongside this:
Mac title screen bug fixed
Letters now save if you start a game from a previous chapter in title sceen
Rendering issue in Chapter 9
Fixed several confrontations not allowing the correct clues
Several minor bug fixes
Several writing fixes

notes.title: Weird aesthetics abound in point-and-click comsic gothic Blood on the Thames
